summary: Claude Code can exhaust its automatic retries while its authentication state keeps returning 401 responses.
evidence: One recorded request advanced through retry attempts 1–9 and ended with HTTP 401; no prompt content was retained.
fix_steps: Run `claude auth login` to refresh the local credential.
Restart the affected Claude Code session instead of allowing the same request to retry again.

summary: Repeated 502 responses can turn one Claude Code request into a costly retry storm.
evidence: A recorded request produced four consecutive HTTP 502 retry records before changing failure class; no prompt content was retained.
fix_steps: Pause the session after two consecutive gateway failures rather than starting another parallel retry chain.
Resume with one request after the service recovers.

summary: The configured TradingView MCP server can be present while its health check repeatedly fails to connect.
evidence: TradingView health checks returned connection-class tool errors across multiple recorded sessions; no tool payloads were retained.
fix_steps: Restart the local TradingView MCP process and run its health check once.
If the health check still fails, verify that the configured local command exists before retrying chart tools.

summary: Claude Preview and Browser preview-start calls can remain stuck in a permission failure state on macOS.
evidence: Preview-start tools returned repeated permission-class errors in separate recorded sessions; no page or project content was retained.
fix_steps: Stop any stale local preview and start a fresh preview from the intended project directory.
Reconfirm the local preview permission before issuing more browser actions.
